chunks: Abu Sulayman Ahmad ibn Hawtha Abu Hurayra al-Bahili informed us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Ishaq an-Nahawandi narrated to us in the year three and seventy of the two hundred, saying: Abu Muhammad Abdullah ibn Hammad al-Ansari narrated to us in the year nine and twenty of the two hundred, saying: Amr ibn Shimr narrated from al-Mubarak ibn Fudala, from al-Hasan ibn Abi al-Hasan al-Basri, who raised it (to the Prophet/Imam), saying:

Gabriel came to the Prophet and said: 'O Muhammad! Allah orders you to marry Fatima to your brother Ali.' So the Messenger of Allah sent for Ali and said to him: 'O Ali, I am marrying you to my daughter Fatima, the mistress of the women of the world and the most beloved of them to me after you. And from you two will be the two masters of the youth of the people of Paradise and the martyrs, bloodstained and oppressed on the earth after me, and the noble, prominent ones, with whom Allah will extinguish injustice, revive the truth, and kill the falsehood; their number is the number of the months of a year, the last of them will be prayed behind by Jesus, son of Mary.'

key_terms.سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ: Mistress of the women of the world

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the marriage between Fatima and Ali in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* underscores the divine origin of the marriage of Fatima and Ali, framing it as a cosmic event that establishes the Ahl al-Bayt as the instruments of divine justice. It explicitly links the martyrdom of their sons to the concept of 'bloodstained' (al-mudarrajun) leaders, a key Shia eschatological motif, while identifying the 'twelve noble ones' (al-nujaba al-zuhur) whose count mirrors the months of the lunar year, culminating with the Last Imam under whose leadership Jesus (as) will pray. This narration serves as a foundational proof for the number and spiritual authority of the Twelve Imams within Shia tradition.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (1) Abu Sulayman bin Hawtha al-Bahili narrated from Ibraheem bin Iss’haq an-Nahawandi from Abu Muhammad Abdullah bin Hammad al-Ansari from Amr bin Shimr from al-Mubarak bin Fudhala that al-Hasan bin Abul Hasan al-Basri had said:

“Gabriel came to the Prophet (S) and said: “O Muhammad! Allah orders you to marry Fatima to your brother Ali.” The Prophet (S) sent for Ali and said to him: “O Ali, I will marry my daughter Fatima, the head lady of the women of the world and the most beloved one to me, to you and there will be from you (your offspring) the two masters of the martyrs of Paradise, the oppressed bloodstained martyrs on the earth after me and the highborn progeny, with whom Allah will defeat injustice, revive the truth and finish off the untruth. Their number is like the number of the months of a year. Behind the last one of them Prophet Jesus the son of Blessed Virgin Mary (as) will offer the prayer.”
